records.source: Sometimes, a strange feeling comes over me. My head becomes totally empty... and I feel completely at peace, even blissful.#$e#Hey, now! It has nothing to do with drinking wine!$h
records.translation: 有時候，一種奇妙的感覺會湧上心頭。腦海變得一片空白……我感到徹底平靜，甚至無比幸福。#$e#嘿！這跟喝酒一點關係也沒有！$h

records.source: Do you ever wonder what it's like to be a different person?#$e#Do our thoughts manifest in a similar way, or is it radically different?#$e#Don't mind me, I think about weird things sometimes...$h
records.translation: 你有沒有想過，成為另一個人是什麼感覺？#$e#我們的思緒會以相似的方式呈現，還是截然不同？#$e#別在意我，我有時會思考一些奇怪的事……$h

records.source: I love to decorate for the different seasons.
records.translation: 我喜歡隨著不同季節布置住處。

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#I've thought about growing some crops, but I think I'd feel bad having to clear out all the wild plants to make space.|Farming sounds so fun. I want to try it, someday.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#我想過種些作物，但要清除所有野生植物騰出空間，感覺會很過意不去。|務農聽起來真有趣。我想改天試試。$l

records.source: If you hear any banging from inside my hut, it's probably just me working on one of my sculptures.
records.translation: 如果你聽見我的小屋裡傳出敲打聲，大概只是我在製作某件雕塑。

records.source: If you ever find any interesting looking driftwood, I could use it.#$e#It would be special that you gave it to me.
records.translation: 如果你找到外形有趣的漂流木，我用得上。#$e#因為是你送的，它會格外特別。

records.source: ...What?$7#$b#Oh! Yeah, that's absolutely right!$h
records.translation: ……什麼？$7#$b#喔！對，完全正確！$h

records.source: There's nothing wrong with that... I think there's lots of beauty to be found in raw, untouched nature!#$b#But as a human, I'm also interested in how we shape and interpret the world around us... I guess what I'm saying is that I'm interested in 'art'.
records.translation: 那沒什麼不好……我認為原始、未經人手的大自然中蘊含著許多美！#$b#但身為人類，我也對我們如何塑造並詮釋周遭世界感興趣……我想我的意思是，我對「藝術」感興趣。

records.source: You pig!%fork$a^Oh! You're...? Me too.$6#$b#Get out!$a^That's good to know.$l
records.translation: 你這頭豬！%fork$a^喔！你是……？我也是。$6#$b#出去！$a^知道這件事真好。$l

records.source: You're right... I just wouldn't have been happy back there.$u#$b#It was better for both of us... to end an unsustainable relationship while we were still young and flexible.$u
records.translation: 你說得對……留在那裡我根本不會快樂。$u#$b#趁我們還年輕、還能適應時結束一段無法長久的關係……對雙方都更好。$u

records.source: That's a little harsh... but, yeah. We had different priorities.$u
records.translation: 這話有點嚴厲……不過，是啊。我們重視的事情不同。$u

records.source: Oh yeah? Well maybe I'll just leave, then!%fork$a
records.translation: 是嗎？好啊，那我乾脆離開算了！%fork$a

records.source: *sigh*...$s#$b#I guess you're right... it was kind of selfish. But can you really blame me for wanting to be happy? Ugh... I don't know...$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……$s#$b#我想你說得對……那樣是有點自私。但我只是想獲得幸福，你真的能怪我嗎？唉……我不知道……$s

records.source: *sigh*...$s#$b#Maybe you're right... Humans are selfish creatures. I don't know. $s#$b#I probably shouldn't dwell on it. We all have to make hard choices from time to time.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……$s#$b#也許你說得對……人類是自私的生物。我不知道。$s#$b#我大概不該一直糾結。我們偶爾都得做出艱難的選擇。$s

records.source: You can tell it's summer by the sweet smell of nectar wafting through the air!$h
records.translation: 空氣中飄散著香甜的花蜜氣息，一聞就知道夏天到了！$h

records.source: I found some wild fruits this morning!#$e#Sorry, I don't have any left.$s#$e#Keep looking, I'm sure you'll find something.
records.translation: 我今天早上找到了一些野果！#$e#抱歉，已經一顆都不剩了。$s#$e#繼續找吧，我相信你一定會有所收穫。

records.source: The sound of farm animals is great, isn't it?
records.translation: 農場動物的叫聲很好聽，不是嗎？

records.source: The simple things in life are best: a soft summer breeze, majestic clouds, and a goblet full of Stardew Valley red.
records.translation: 生活中簡單的事物最美好：輕柔的夏日微風、壯麗的雲朵，還有一高腳杯的星露谷紅酒。

records.source: I have a good eye for wild fruit. Some day I'll make you a nice fruit salad.$h
records.translation: 我很會尋找野果。改天我會替你做份美味的水果沙拉。$h

records.source: You can use a tapper to harvest syrups and other useful liquids directly from trees.#$e#It's a slow process, but the result can be quite valuable.
records.translation: 你可以用樹液採集器直接從樹上採集糖漿和其他有用的液體。#$e#這個過程很緩慢，但產物可能相當值錢。

records.source: I hate to be blunt, but if we don't treat nature with respect, our grandchildren will be doomed.#$e#Don't you think so?
records.translation: 我不想把話說得太直接，但如果我們不尊重大自然，我們的子孫就完了。#$e#你不這麼認為嗎？

records.source: Do you ever walk out into the forest... Pause... And simply enjoy the beauty of nature?#$e#It's easy to forget how incredible this world actually is...
records.translation: 你有沒有走進森林……停下腳步……只是靜靜欣賞大自然的美？#$e#人很容易忘記這個世界其實有多麼不可思議……

records.source: Hello, @. Do you ever get lonely on that big farm?#$e#Stop by my cabin if you ever need someone to talk to.$h
records.translation: 你好，@。你在那座大農場裡會不會感到孤單？#$e#如果你需要找人聊聊，隨時來我的小屋坐坐。$h

records.source: The flowing water keeps my house a little bit cooler in summer.#$e#I can't tolerate heat very well.
records.translation: 流動的河水讓我的房子在夏天稍微涼爽一些。#$e#我不太耐熱。

records.source: One Summer, it was so hot during the night that I got out of bed and jumped into the river!#$e#I hope no one saw me!$h
records.translation: 有一年夏天，夜裡熱得讓我爬下床，直接跳進河裡！#$e#希望沒有人看到我！$h

records.source: What should I do on such a warm, lazy day? *sigh*#$e#Any ideas?
records.translation: 這麼溫暖慵懶的一天，我該做些什麼？*嘆氣*#$e#有什麼主意嗎？

records.source: How quickly the seasons change!#$e#It's shocking.
records.translation: 季節變換得真快！#$e#令人吃驚。

records.source: #$c .5#I found some wild mushrooms over the weekend!#$e#I had a huge plate of wild mushrooms and eggs for breakfast today... I'm still full.#$e#Keep your nose to the ground and you'll find some mushrooms yourself... I'm sure of it.
records.translation: #$c .5#我週末找到了一些野菇！#$e#今天早餐我吃了一大盤野菇和蛋……現在還很飽。#$e#仔細在地上找找，你自己也能發現一些蘑菇……我敢肯定。

records.source: I wonder if I could make a collage out of dried leaves?#$e#They're just so colorful... I can't help but think of the potential for art projects.$h
records.translation: 不知道我能不能用乾燥葉片製作拼貼畫？#$e#它們的色彩如此豐富……讓我忍不住想到各種藝術創作的可能性。$h

records.source: Everyone has a unique and interesting perspective, whether they believe it or not. Don't you think so?#$e#Although, some people have opinions that I just can't respect.
records.translation: 無論是否相信，每個人都有獨特而有趣的視角。你不這麼認為嗎？#$e#不過，有些人的觀點我實在無法尊重。

records.source: It's so nice to live by the river.#$e#I fall asleep to the soothing sound of water every night.
records.translation: 住在河邊真好。#$e#每晚我都伴著令人安心的流水聲入睡。

records.source: One of these days I'll have to make you a wild mushroom stir-fry.$h
records.translation: 改天我一定要替你做一道炒野菇。$h

records.source: Do you have a kitchen in your house?#$e#If you have a kitchen, you can cook all kinds of delicious meals.$h
records.translation: 你家裡有廚房嗎？#$e#有了廚房，就能烹調各種美味料理。$h

records.source: Stop by my cabin if you ever need someone to talk to.$h
records.translation: 如果你需要找人聊聊，隨時來我的小屋坐坐。$h

records.source: Decorations accentuate the feeling of the season. I think it's a worthwhile tradition.
records.translation: 裝飾能突顯季節的氛圍。我認為這是值得延續的傳統。

records.source: There's a lot of good places to walk around here.#$e#It feels good to stretch your legs.
records.translation: 這附近有很多適合散步的好地方。#$e#活動一下雙腿很舒服。

records.source: One thing I love about this place is that there are beautiful waterfalls.#$e#Do you ever spend time watching them? It's soothing...
records.translation: 我喜歡這裡的一點，就是有美麗的瀑布。#$e#你會花時間看著它們嗎？很療癒的……

records.source: I love the way everything looks when it's covered with fresh snow.
records.translation: 我喜歡萬物覆上新雪時的模樣。

records.source: It gets pretty cold in my little cabin.$s#$e#I just snuggle up under a huge blanket, and I'm okay.$h
records.translation: 我的小屋裡會變得相當寒冷。$s#$e#不過只要窩在一條大毯子底下，我就沒事了。$h

records.source: I saw a snow rabbit early this morning! They're rare, aren't they?
records.translation: 今天一大早我看到了一隻雪兔！牠們很罕見，對吧？

records.source: I'm having a hard time finding fresh food to eat.#$e#I've been eating a lot of bread.$s
records.translation: 我很難找到新鮮食物。#$e#最近吃了很多麵包。$s

records.source: *Sigh*... It's hard to get fresh food in the winter.#$e#I bet your farm is pretty well stocked with food, huh?
records.translation: *嘆氣*……冬天很難取得新鮮食物。#$e#我敢說你的農場裡儲備了不少食物，對吧？

records.source: Time seems to move slower here.#$e#When I lived in the city, the year went by so fast.
records.translation: 時間在這裡似乎過得比較慢。#$e#我住在城市時，一年轉眼就過去了。

records.source: Do you ever get cold in that farmhouse of yours?#$e#Stop by my cabin if you want to huddle under one of my quilts and drink cider.$h
records.translation: 你的農舍裡會不會很冷？#$e#如果你想窩在我的拼布被下喝蘋果酒，就來小屋坐坐。$h

records.source: Hello. Do you want something?
records.translation: 你好。你有什麼事嗎？

records.source: Hello, @. Is there something you wanted to talk about?
records.translation: 你好，@。你有什麼事想聊嗎？

records.source: Do you ever take a whole day off?#$e#It's a refreshing break.
records.translation: 你會放一整天假嗎？#$e#那能讓人恢復精神。

records.source: You should take a whole day off, now and then.#$b#Not only is it good for the soul, but in the long run, you'll actually be more productive!
records.translation: 你偶爾應該放一整天假。#$b#這不只對心靈有益，長遠來看還能讓你更有效率！
